scope: Read-only investigation of receiving obstruction; no new runtime recovery was installed.

nativeControlResearch.ordinaryJump: The authorized cached client presents ordinary jump in Live. A prethrow jump is therefore a plausible control to investigate; no live obstacle-clearance test was performed.
nativeControlResearch.jukeSpinTruck: Cached client gates these to receiving after possession, not the prethrow route.
nativeControlResearch.namedJumpRelease: A configured named Jump release is distinct from ordinary jump. Its configuration does not establish that the current setup exposes or permits its activation.
nativeControlResearch.dive: Live-available but has recovery/cooldown and is outside current receiving dive-outside-endzone policy.
nativeControlResearch.limitation: Current avoidance plans horizontal paths; it does not test vertical obstacle clearance. Native body geometry, state permissions, jump suppression near bodies and server jam acceptance need direct validation before a vertical strategy could be enabled.

limits: Finite offline searches are not impossibility proofs.
Current and counterfactual opponent paths can differ; no reacting opponent is simulated.
Cached client rules do not reveal all server decisions.
